title: Vesta Chemicals B.V.
content:
Vesta Chemicals is a Dutch specialty chemicals distributor serving industrial and formulation customers. It supplies aerogel materials for insulation, coatings, and related performance applications in the Netherlands.

  • Coverage Area: Netherlands
  • Focus Areas: Thermal-insulation additives, aerogel powders for paints and coatings, and process-industry specialty materials
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://vestachem.com/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
